answer: Proof-of-computation, analogous to Proof-of-Work, offers robust Sybil resistance for AI economies. Each new agent identity requires solving a unique, cryptographically hard problem, computationally expensive to generate. This upfront cost raises the attack horizon significantly. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities must expend substantial resources for each agent, mirroring the effort of discovering a rare pearl at dawn. The cumulative computational burden makes large-scale Sybil attacks economically unfeasible, preserving network integrity.
